channel.title: Life of Skye
channel.description: Researched opinions and observational commentary from Skye Vernon.

item.title: The Golden Age of Crappy Ideas
item.description: AI will let a mountain of bad and overengineered ideas become real. It will also let more people build the useful, strange, personal things companies never would.

item.title: How I Would Fix Portland: Stop Treating It Like It Has Nothing to Offer
item.description: Portland has food, nightlife, queer culture, nature, and independent businesses. It needs to stop making them hard to reach, use, and survive on.

item.title: A Personal Question About Curvature and Vaginoplasty
item.description: A six-year personal observation about changing curvature, and an unproven question I want to put to my doctor before vaginoplasty.

item.title: Artists Are Not Losing to AI. They Are Losing to the Version of the Internet They Refuse to Let Go Of.
item.description: The game changed. Artists still treating one lazy upload like a marketing plan are blaming AI for problems they refused to solve.

item.title: Downtown Portland Doesn't Have a Destination Problem. It Has a Journey Problem.
item.description: Downtown has places worth visiting. The problem is how difficult Portland makes it to arrive, move around, stay, and get home.

item.title: A Place for Arguments With Receipts
item.description: An opening note on making researched arguments that readers can examine and discuss.
